items.title: Route `/settings/secrets` renders Secrets
acceptance: GIVEN an authenticated user with a selected project
WHEN the browser navigates to a URL matching /settings/secrets
THEN the secrets screen is displayed at that URL
AND the location, parameters and history behave exactly as in the baseline application

items.title: Endpoint GET /secrets/secrets/default/{projectId} (secretsList)
acceptance: GIVEN the user performs the secrets list operation
WHEN the client issues the request
THEN it targets GET /secrets/secrets/default/{projectId} with the same parameters, body shape and semantics as the baseline
AND the response payload drives the same visible data as in the baseline, with error responses surfaced as an error state instead of a blank screen

items.title: Endpoint POST /secrets/secrets/default/{projectId} (secretAdding)
acceptance: GIVEN the user performs the secret adding operation
WHEN the client issues the request
THEN it targets POST /secrets/secrets/default/{projectId} with the same parameters, body shape and semantics as the baseline
AND on success the affected lists and detail views reflect the change without a manual refresh, while failures surface an error state

items.title: Permission `configuration.secrets.secret.delete` gates its UI
acceptance: GIVEN a user whose project role does not include configuration.secrets.secret.delete
WHEN the screens that reference this permission render
THEN the gated controls, tabs or routes are hidden or disabled exactly as in the baseline
AND granting the permission makes them available without any other change
